functionalRequirements.description: Add Prisma enums InvoiceStatus (DRAFT, ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, OVERDUE, VOID), PaymentMethod (CASH, BANK_TRANSFER, CHEQUE, CARD_TERMINAL, OTHER) and DiscountKind (PERCENT, FIXED).

Add models FeeItem, FeePlan, FeePlanLine, StudentOptionalFee, Discount, StudentDiscount, Invoice, InvoiceLine, Payment, PaymentAllocation and DocumentSequence with the fields, Decimal(10,2) money columns, uniques and indexes given in the PRD.
Add an InvoiceReminder model { invoiceId, kind, sentAt } to track overdue and pre-due reminders sent per invoice.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-7.2 (model named in prose but missing from the FR-1 schema block)

functionalRequirements.description: Add currency String @default("USD") (ISO 4217) and invoiceFooter String? (bank details or payment instructions) to SchoolSettings.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-1 (last paragraph); Out of Scope (multi-currency)

functionalRequirements.description: Add isBursar Boolean @default(false) to User. It is meaningful only for ADMIN.
Fee setup page /admin/fees/setup, Fee items tab: list and create/edit/archive fee items (name, unique code, description, defaultAmount > 0, isOptional).

Fee plans tab: create and edit plans per academic year and term (termId null = annual) × grade level, with a line editor (fee item + amount), a computed total and dueDays (default 30). PUT replaces all lines.
Discounts tab: create, edit and archive discounts (name, kind PERCENT 0–100 or FIXED amount, optional autoRule SIBLING_2ND | SIBLING_3RD_PLUS, or null for manual).
Optional fees tab: assign optional fee items (for example Bus) to students per academic year with an amount, including a bulk assign for every student in a section.
Student discounts tab: assign manual discounts such as scholarships to students per academic year, with an optional note.

Sibling auto rules: SIBLING_2ND applies to the second and later enrolled siblings who share the same primary parent (ParentStudentLink.isPrimary). SIBLING_3RD_PLUS applies to the third and later siblings.

Invoice generation page /admin/fees/invoices/generate: choose a term (or annual) and one or more grade levels, then preview one row per student with plan lines, optional fees, manual and auto-sibling discounts, and the total.
The preview lists students who already have an invoice for the selected term as 'Skipped — already invoiced', and generation never creates a second invoice for them.

'Create drafts' creates DRAFT invoices. 'Create and issue' also issues them: assigns a number, sets issue date to today and due date to today + plan.dueDays (school timezone), sets status ISSUED and notifies parents (fees.invoice_issued).

Discount calculation: percent discounts apply to the subtotal of non-optional lines, then fixed discounts apply. The total never goes below 0. Each discount is stored as a negative InvoiceLine with isDiscount=true. Rounding is 2 decimals, half-up.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-3.3; NFR Correctness; Acceptance Criteria 1–2

functionalRequirements.description: Invoice and receipt numbers (INV-YYYY-NNNNNN, RCT-YYYY-NNNNNN, sequential per year) come from DocumentSequence inside the issuing or saving transaction with a row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE). Numbers are unique and gap-free under concurrency.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-3.4; FR-1 Invoice.number/Payment.receiptNumber; NFR Concurrency; Acceptance Criterion 3

functionalRequirements.description: Invoices list /admin/fees/invoices: server-side DataTable with number, student, grade/section, term, issue date, due date, total, paid, balance and a status badge.

Invoice list filters: status, term, grade level, section, overdue only, and q search by student name or invoice number. A totals row shows total billed, paid and outstanding for the whole filtered set.
Invoice detail shows the header, lines, allocations (payments applied), balance and an activity timeline from the audit log.
DRAFT invoice actions: edit lines, issue, delete. The API is PATCH/DELETE /api/fees/invoices/:id (DRAFT only) and POST /issue.

ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID and OVERDUE invoice actions: record payment, add an adjustment line (a negative credit-note-style line with a required reason, audited) and void. Void requires a reason and is allowed only when the invoice has no allocations.
PAID invoice action: view the receipt(s) of the payments allocated to it.
Manual invoice: a bursar can create a one-off invoice for a student with free-form lines (for example a trip fee) via POST /api/fees/invoices.

Status recomputation in the same transaction after every allocation, reversal or adjustment: amountPaid >= total → PAID; 0 < amountPaid < total → PARTIALLY_PAID; issued with amountPaid = 0 → ISSUED; ISSUED or PARTIALLY_PAID past dueDate → OVERDUE.
The OVERDUE transition runs both in the daily maintenance run and on read, so lists and details never show a stale non-overdue status.

Record payment page /admin/fees/payments/new: select a parent or student, then load all open invoices of the family (every child linked to that parent) with balances via GET /api/fees/families/:parentId/open-invoices.
Payment form fields: amount (> 0), method, reference, received date/time, payer name (defaults to the primary parent) and notes.

Allocation: auto-allocate oldest due date first by default. The bursar can edit per-invoice allocations. The sum of allocations must equal the payment amount, and no allocation may exceed the invoice balance.
Overpayment is refused with 'Amount exceeds the family's outstanding balance of <formatted amount>', and nothing is saved. Credit balances are out of scope.

Saving a payment assigns a receipt number, updates the invoices' amountPaid and status in the same transaction, notifies the family's parents (fees.payment_received with a receipt link) and opens the receipt.

Payment reversal (bursar, reason required): sets reversedAt and reversalReason, removes the effect of its allocations by recomputing the affected invoices, and is audited. The payment row is never deleted and shows a 'Reversed' status.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-5.4; API POST /api/fees/payments/:id/reverse; Acceptance Criterion 6

functionalRequirements.description: Payments list and detail APIs (GET /api/fees/payments, /:id) for ADMIN, and for PARENT limited to payments allocated to their own children's invoices.

Printable invoice page /fees/invoices/[id]/print: A4 layout with school letterhead, number, dates, student, lines, totals and the invoice footer from settings, plus a 'Print / Save as PDF' button that calls window.print().

Printable receipt page /fees/receipts/[paymentId]/print: A4 layout with letterhead, receipt number, dates, payer, allocations, totals and the amount in words (for example 'One thousand two hundred forty dollars and 00/100'), plus 'Print / Save as PDF'.
All money is formatted with Intl.NumberFormat in the school currency (SchoolSettings.currency).

Register notification types fees.invoice_issued, fees.payment_received (includes a receipt link) and fees.overdue_reminder in src/server/notifications/types.ts. All three default to email on and use the existing FINANCE category, for the PARENT role.

The maintenance run sends automatic reminders to the primary parent and the other linked parents 3 days before the due date, on due date + 1 day, and every 14 days after that while the invoice is overdue. Each send is recorded in InvoiceReminder so no reminder goes out twice.
A bursar can send a manual reminder from the invoice (POST /api/fees/invoices/:id/remind), limited to once per 24 hours per invoice (429/CONFLICT when throttled).

Parent fees page /fees (PARENT): a summary card (total outstanding across children, next due date, overdue amount in red), an invoice list across children with status and balance, invoice detail and print, payment history with receipts, and the invoice footer's payment instructions. Data comes from GET /api/me/fees.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-8.1; API GET /api/me/fees; Acceptance Criterion 9

functionalRequirements.description: The PRD-15 child overview shows a 'Fees' card when the child has an outstanding balance.
Students have no Fees navigation entry and no access to fee pages or APIs.

Fees dashboard /admin/fees: KPI cards (billed this term, collected, outstanding, overdue, collection rate %), a weekly collection trend chart, aging buckets (current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days overdue) and the top 10 overdue families.
Add an 'Outstanding fees' StatCard to the PRD-16 admin dashboard.
CSV exports: invoices (current filters), payments (date range and method filters) and the aging report.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-9.3; Out of Scope (CSV only)

functionalRequirements.description: Permissions: every fee write action requires ADMIN with isBursar=true. Other admins get read-only fee pages and read APIs. Teachers get 403 on every fee page and API. Parents read only their own children's data. Every check is server-side.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-10.1; API table; Acceptance Criterion 8; NFR Security

functionalRequirements.description: Add sidebar entries in src/config/navigation.ts: admin Fees (/admin/fees) with subpages for setup, invoices and payments, and parent Fees (/fees). There is no entry for TEACHER or STUDENT.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 FR-8, FR-9; Platform Context (navigation convention)

functionalRequirements.description: Seed: Alice Admin is a bursar; currency USD; an invoice footer with sample bank details; fee items Tuition, Lab fee, Bus service (optional) and Activity fee; Semester 1 plans for Grades 6–8.

Seed discounts Sibling (SIBLING_2ND 5%) and Merit scholarship (10%, manual, assigned to Sam). Seed issued Semester 1 invoices for Grade 7 with a mix of PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, ISSUED and 3 OVERDUE, and 12 payments across methods.
Unit tests: discount calculation order, sibling rule detection, oldest-first auto-allocation, amount in words, status transitions.
Integration tests: concurrent number allocation, reversal recomputation, and an amountPaid integrity check across random sequences of payments and reversals.
Playwright e2e test: a bursar generates term invoices, records a payment and prints the receipt, then the parent sees the updated balance.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Correctness: money is Decimal everywhere (no JS float arithmetic) with 2-decimal half-up rounding. Invoice.amountPaid always equals the sum of non-reversed allocations; this is enforced by recomputation in every write transaction and verified by an integrity test.
Auditability: issued invoices and payments are never hard-deleted (void and reverse instead). Every fee mutation writes an AuditLog entry with before and after values via audit().
Concurrency: parallel invoice generation, manual invoices and payment recording never produce duplicate or skipped invoice or receipt numbers.

Security: parents access only invoices and payments of linked children. Every ID in a URL (invoice, payment, student, parent) is access-checked server-side. Hiding a button is never the only protection.
Performance: the office can generate a whole term's invoices for every student in under 5 minutes end to end.

UI component rule: build only with MUI (@mui/material v9, icons, x-data-grid, x-date-pickers, x-charts). Look up every component through the MUI MCP server (useMuiDocs/fetchDocs) and use only documented props. Banned libraries are not allowed (Tailwind, shadcn, Radix, Recharts, notistack and the others listed). QA must verify there are no banned imports and that every MUI import is documented.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 Platform Context — UI component rule (items 1–6)

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: API conventions: thin Zod-validated route handlers under src/app/api/fees/… calling a service at src/server/fees/fees-service.ts (feature subdirectory). Standard response and error shapes, error codes, pagination (page, pageSize ≤ 100), sort and q.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 Platform Context — Code layout and conventions

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Dates: timestamps are stored in UTC. issueDate and dueDate are @db.Date and all date rules (due, overdue, reminder schedule, 'today') are evaluated in SchoolSettings.timezone.

Brownfield: reuse the existing helpers (audit(), notify(), requireRole, DataTable, StatCard, useToast, src/server/csv.ts, the maintenance pass and the parent overview service). Do not re-scaffold, duplicate or rename existing routes or models. No console.log; use logger.
Regression gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test stay green, and the PRD's new tests are added.
Scope guard: no online payment gateways or stored cards, no accounting integrations beyond CSV, no multi-currency, no tax/VAT, no credit balances, and no changes to behaviour owned by PRD-18.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-17 Out of Scope; FR-5.2; Constraints

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Print layouts render cleanly at A4 through the browser print dialog (theme or sx print media styles only, no CSS modules).

questions: Invoice.number is a non-null @unique String, but DRAFT invoices get a number only at issue. Should number become nullable (String? @unique, since Postgres allows multiple NULLs), or should drafts hold a placeholder?
InvoiceReminder is named in FR-7.2 but missing from the FR-1 schema. Confirm the shape { id, invoiceId, kind, sentAt } and the kind values (PRE_DUE_3D, DUE_PLUS_1, OVERDUE_14D, MANUAL).
FeePlan @@unique([termId, gradeLevelId]) does not stop duplicate annual plans (termId NULL) and does not include academicYearId. Should annual plans be unique per (academicYearId, gradeLevelId)?
What is the sibling order for SIBLING_2ND / SIBLING_3RD_PLUS: StudentProfile.enrollmentDate, date of birth, or something else? 'Second-youngest-enrolled' is ambiguous.
The PRD convention says 'every model has createdAt and updatedAt', but several fee models (FeeItem, FeePlan, Discount, Payment, …) omit them. Add them anyway?
Which invoices count as 'already invoiced' for skipping: any non-VOID invoice with the same termId for the student (and for annual: termId NULL in the same academic year)? Do manual invoices count?
Throttled manual reminder: should it return RATE_LIMITED (429) or CONFLICT (409)?
Amount in words for non-USD currencies: what are the major/minor unit names?
unresolved: Invoice.number nullability for DRAFT. Default: String? @unique, assigned at issue.
InvoiceReminder shape. Default: { id, invoiceId, kind String, sentAt } with @@index([invoiceId, kind]).
Annual FeePlan uniqueness. Default: enforce in the service (one plan per academicYearId + gradeLevelId + termId, NULL-safe).
Sibling ordering. Default: enrollmentDate ascending, tie-break by dateOfBirth descending (older first), among non-archived students sharing the primary parent.
createdAt/updatedAt on fee models. Default: add them (follows the platform convention; harmless).
Skip rule. Default: an existing non-VOID invoice that was generated from a plan for the same student and termId (annual: same academic year with termId NULL). Manual invoices do not cause a skip.
Amount-in-words currency names. Default: USD wording ('dollars'), with the ISO code as a fallback for other currencies.
